subject: Acorn Labs — trial extension request + matching allowance review
messages:
From: Sophia Chen <sophia@acornlabs.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@acornlabs.com
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: short trial extension + matching demo allowance

Hi Lukas —

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. The team at Acorn Labs is excited about the latency and cost numbers you pulled for our summarization workload. We're about to run our internal 'demo day' on Dec 6 and would like to show a longer session using the same model/profile.

Two asks:
1) Can Redwood extend our trial sandbox by an extra 12 days so the demo day team can rehearse the full 40-minute session (we used up the original credits during load testing)?
2) Would Redwood consider a small matching allowance — effectively a $2k promotional bump tied to us completing the demo and a short case study? We can commit to a 6-week evaluation with usage targets if that helps.

I've attached a quick milestone matrix and current product summary. Happy to jump on a 20m call if you want to align.

Best,
Sophia Chen
Head of Growth, Acorn Labs
(sophia@acornlabs.com)

Attachments: acorn_product_snapshot.pdf, milestone_matrix.xlsx

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Request: short trial extension + matching demo allowance

Marissa / Ben —

Looping you in on Acorn's note (below). They have a demo day on Dec 6 and are asking for a 12-day sandbox extension plus a $2k promotional match conditional on a case study and usage milestone (we'd define the metric).

Quick context: Acorn is an early-stage YC-alike startup building meeting intelligence for distributed product teams. Their expected token volumes are modest but the demo needs consistent low-latency for long transcripts. We ran their small load test and latency looked excellent on the t4/8 setup.

Decision required:
- Approve sandbox extension? (Ops policy usually allows one short extension for demos)
- Approve promotional matching allowance $2k (PR/marketing sign-off and legal should be minimal for a case study)

My recommendation: Approve extension immediately; approve promo match but tie it to a short success criteria: 40-minute demo completed + a 2-paragraph case study + 2 quick metrics (avg latency < 360ms, < $0.015/token). If acceptable I'll confirm with Sophia and prep a short MOU.

Thanks,
Lukas Meyer
Account Executive — Startup Programs
Redwood Inference

Lukas / Ben —

Thanks for the context. Approve the sandbox extension for 14 days (give them a little buffer). For the promotional match: approve $2k credit but please structure it as marketing/PR spend — require the case study and the two metrics you suggested. That lets us classify the expense under demand-gen and keeps procurement paperwork minimal.

Please include these conditions in the confirmation email and attach the short MOU. Legal doesn't need to review for this size, but include a statement that credits expire 30 days after issuance if not used. Also ask ops to set up a dedicated sandbox project with the token limit flagged for monitoring.

Ben, can you create the sandbox and flag alerts for average latency and token burn so we can validate the milestone?

Marissa

Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Request: short trial extension + matching demo allowance

Hi Sophia —

Great news: we can extend your sandbox through Dec 20 (14-day secure extension) and provide a $2,000 promotional credit contingent on the demo + short case study. To summarize the conditions:

- Extension: sandbox access extended from Nov 26 to Dec 20 (project: acorn-demo-2026).
- Promotional credit: $2,000 Redwood credit applied after Acorn completes the demo and provides a 2-paragraph case study.
- Success metrics required for credit: average API latency <= 360ms across demo traffic AND effective unit cost <= $0.015/token (we will check token burn report).
- Credit expiry: promotional credit will expire 30 days after issuance if unused.

Ben (cc'd) will provision the dedicated demo sandbox and set monitoring alerts for latency and token burn. We'll also schedule a 15m smoke test session the week before the demo.

If that all looks good, reply with a quick confirmation and preferred time for the smoke test. Congrats to the Acorn team — excited to see the demo.

Best,
Lukas Meyer
Account Executive — Startup Programs
Redwood Inference
